## Cat Key 1.1.0: the cat learned some new tricks

**⬇ [Download for Windows](https://github.com/MasterfullyClaw/CatKey/releases/latest/download/CatKey-Setup-x64.exe)**, or the [portable exe](https://github.com/MasterfullyClaw/CatKey/releases/latest/download/CatKey-portable-x64.exe).

### New
- **Library:** 21 ready-made packs, 748 shortcuts. Mac ⇄ Windows switching, Windows power keys, and the pro shortcuts of Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, Photoshop, Illustrator, Lightroom, Figma, Blender, Cinema 4D, VS Code, Obsidian and browsers.
- **Train yourself:** a game that makes shortcuts automatic. It has spaced review, streaks, a score, a timer and a progress dashboard, and it counts real use in the app.
- **Cat Builder:** shortcuts for any app, written by ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity or Gemini in one click, then picked up when you copy the answer.
- **Share codes** (one line of text per pack), whole-setup export and import (Mac ⇄ Windows translation included), and multi-select to switch on/off, delete, export or share many shortcuts at once.

### Fixed
- **The first Alt shortcut after pressing Alt did nothing** when PowerToys Grab And Move was on. Fixed.
- A key release that went missing can no longer swallow your next press. A watchdog repairs missed releases, and keys are sent from their own thread, so a slow program can't make Windows skip Cat Key.
- Pressing Alt a hair after another key no longer opens the app's menu (the next shortcut used to ding).
- Single-letter remaps pause while you type in a text box.
